requirementAssessment.reason: Public and driver capability messages expose names/versions, not the required three-role nonwriting profile acknowledgement. Driver version is daemon version.
Docker create body leaves readonly_rootfs unset; internal RO binds do not configure a read-only child root.
Driver accepts typed user mounts and image volume metadata; no complete child mount sealing/attestation path is provided.
Empty or root image workdir maps to /sandbox; managed preparation or custom write probe requires writable workspace. No workspace none mode.
Explicit argv is carried directly, but missing command falls back to bash; exact immutable executable and secondary-exec exclusion are not proven jointly.
Image ID selection exists, but ImageMetadata/provisioning has no requested exact fixture path/type/mode/owner/size/hash verification gate. Actual fixture membership remains unproven.
Privilege drop, hardening and Landlock exist; complete child mount/PID/IPC/control isolation is not attested by source-only evidence.
Empty authored groups still convert to Proxy mode and combined supervisor networking; this is not the explicit no-network/no-GPU profile.
Stdio pipes and pre_exec exist; an independently observed closed final FD allowlist with no inherited control resource is unproven.
Combined supervisor creates log/control/proxy/workspace state in the common container topology; optional SPIFFE masking is not complete child namespace state separation.
Only conditional grant preservation is proven. Loader fallback/enrichment/global/provider/update routes remain available, without required sealed profile post-loader acknowledgement.
CPU/RAM/PIDs alone do not supply profile-wide finite capture/state/deadline evidence; driver leaves log/shm/swap controls unspecified and supervisor file retention is not a byte cap.
Stop/start retains container state; gateway starts persisted sandboxes. No single-use receipt and fresh-state-only recovery contract.
Public/driver/supervisor schema lacks complete trusted pre-exec profile receipt and exact hash acknowledgement. Requested configuration is not observed state.
Ordinary additive API behavior exists, but profile-specific fail-closed negotiation and backward-compatibility tests cannot be established for an absent profile.
No newer stable candidate exists. The four cumulative profile-specific qualification levels are not established by retained source review or generic tests.
